findings.summary: deploy/templates/board.yaml:78-90: no check in the repo fails without this change. CI only runs helm lint and kubeconform, and both pass if GITHUB_APP_ID or GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY is missing or loses optional: true. Checked by hand with helm template (both render from sdlc-board-tokens with optional: true, no key material); say so in the PR. The last clause of AC-6 can only be checked after the merge and the owner's setup.

argocd/README.md:44-45: the second patch put the whole base64-encoded private key on kubectl's command line, readable via ps or /proc/<pid>/cmdline while it runs. Keep the key out of argv, e.g. a dry-run secret rendered into a patch file.
argocd/README.md:51-53: the README says to remove the old GITHUB_TOKEN key once the App works but gives no command for it.
